exact_recap:
THIS WEEK IN AUSTIN

A wider trial, with results still unknown

The appointment-free document-check trial grew from a plan for one center into an operating option at three, with a commitment to keep it through October 30. Monday’s announcement contemplated a Wednesday test at one center; the revised plan expanded that same trial to three centers starting Wednesday. By Friday’s cutoff, those centers had completed two operating days.

The change is in where visitors can seek checks without an appointment. Existing hours and eligibility remain unchanged. The longer commitment does not yet establish better outcomes: measured wait-time and application-completion results are not available.

Sources: Synthetic service access memo; Synthetic service access revision; Synthetic service access operations note
